items.name: Bed, hospital
items.notes: Vanilla hospital bed model; LF already reuses its .xob in LF_HospitalBed and LF_FirstSpawnBed. The vanilla prefab itself is a static destructible mesh with no actions. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Medical waste bin
items.notes: Clinic corner filler; mesh only (non-destructible). Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Medical cabinet (double)
items.notes: Glass-front clinic cabinet; mesh only, no storage or open action, so it is set dressing. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Medical cabinet (single)
items.notes: Narrow variant of the clinic cabinet; mesh only, no storage. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Medical exam lamp
items.notes: Floor exam lamp; mesh only (no light component found). Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Medical scale
items.notes: Floor scale; mesh only, non-destructible. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: IV / infusion stand
items.notes: Not placed anywhere on vanilla Everon; mesh only. Pairs with the hospital bed.

items.name: Surgical lamp
items.notes: Surgical lamp (a LampSurgical_01_on variant exists for the lit state); unused on Everon.

items.name: Medical monitor screen
items.notes: Vital-signs screen; mesh only, unused on Everon.

items.name: Instrument sterilizer
items.notes: Low counter-top sterilizer; unused on Everon.

items.name: Medical table
items.notes: Instrument/exam table; a _small variant exists; unused on Everon.

items.name: Medical table (small)
items.notes: Narrow instrument table, non-destructible; unused on Everon.

items.name: Surgical table
items.notes: Operating table; mesh only, no lie-down action; unused on Everon.

items.name: Autoclave drum on stand
items.notes: Sterilizer drum on stand (V1; V2 exists); unused on Everon.

items.name: First aid box (wall)
items.notes: Wall-mounted first-aid box; very common. Mesh only: no heal action or storage, so it is decoration. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Philippe: FireStation_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: FireStation_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: FireStation_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Dental chair
items.notes: Part of a dental set (chair, lamp, stool), all unused on Everon; no sit action.

items.name: Dental lamp
items.notes: Part of the dental set; mesh only.

items.name: Dental stool
items.notes: Part of the dental set; mesh only.

items.name: Medical equipment box (US)
items.notes: Wooden crate with a storage inventory and an Open Storage action; the only vanilla medical prop with storage besides the arsenal box.

items.name: Medical arsenal box (US)
items.notes: Medical arsenal crate: arsenal, resupply and save-loadout actions. Vanilla arsenal logic would bypass the LF economy; FIA and USSR variants exist.

items.name: Fire extinguisher
items.notes: Very common; destructible with an extra hit zone; no use action (cannot be fired), so decoration only. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: FireStation_E_01; Saint Pierre: FireStation_E_01; Montignac: FireStation_E_01.

items.name: Fire extinguisher wall box
items.notes: Red wall cabinet with extinguisher, Saint Philippe only; hit zone present, no action.

items.name: Fire extinguisher box with shovel
items.notes: Shovel part of the extinguisher box setup; same 8 instances, Saint Philippe only.

items.name: Hydrant box
items.notes: Fire hydrant cabinet; destructible, no hose or water action. A USSR variant (HydrantBox_USSR_01) exists but is unused on Everon. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Fire station hose hanger
items.notes: Tall hose-drying tower that belongs to FireStation_E_01 (8.96 m high); a building add-on, not a loose prop. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: FireStation_E_01; Saint Pierre: FireStation_E_01; Montignac: FireStation_E_01.

items.name: Fire station siren
items.notes: Building part, 1 on Everon; mesh only (the Amplion_Siren prefab carries the sound and signal components).

items.name: School desk
items.notes: Common in all four towns; destructible; no sit action. Pair with ChairSchool_01. No dedicated school building; MunicipalOffice_E_01_school variants exist.

items.name: School chair
items.notes: Loose chair; no sit action on the vanilla prefab, so seating RP needs an LF sit hook.

items.name: Chalkboard
items.notes: Present in game data but placed 0 times on Everon; an _open variant exists. Best school-room backdrop.

items.name: Flipchart
items.notes: Easel board for classroom or briefing use; GUID not resolvable from the pak data (use asset_search); unused on Everon.

items.name: Globe
items.notes: Desk globe, tiny.

items.name: Cork notice board
items.notes: Wall notice board; posters and filled variants exist; a place for notices or job boards. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Philippe: FireStation_E_01; Saint Pierre: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Saint Pierre: FireStation_E_01; Morton: MunicipalOffice_E_01; Montignac: FireStation_E_01; Montignac: MunicipalOffice_E_01.

items.name: Church bench long
items.notes: Pew, 4.81 m. Count includes _long_front and _long_simple variants. Only in the three big churches (Saint Philippe, Morton, Montignac). Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: Church_01_red; Morton: Church_01_blue_nocellar; Montignac: Church_01_yellow.

items.name: Church bench short
items.notes: Pew, 2.13 m. Count includes _short_front, _short_simple and _base variants. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: Church_01_red; Morton: Church_01_blue_nocellar; Montignac: Church_01_yellow.

items.name: Church bench small
items.notes: Small-church pew; Saint Pierre small church (ChurchSmall_E_01). Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Pierre: ChurchSmall_E_01.

items.name: Candle holder
items.notes: Decorative candle holder, unused on Everon.

items.name: Church altar
items.notes: Large altar building part (8.3 m wide, 8 m high); one per big church. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: Church_01_red; Morton: Church_01_blue_nocellar; Montignac: Church_01_yellow.

items.name: Church altar (small)
items.notes: Small altar / table; also used in Saint Pierre small church. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: Church_01_red; Saint Pierre: ChurchSmall_E_01; Morton: Church_01_blue_nocellar; Montignac: Church_01_yellow.

items.name: Church organ
items.notes: Has a real user action: SCR_PlayInstrument (Prelude in C minor, 11.5 s, context Play); one per big church. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: Church_01_red; Morton: Church_01_blue_nocellar; Montignac: Church_01_yellow.

items.name: Baptismal font
items.notes: Small font decor in the small church (Saint Pierre). Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Pierre: ChurchSmall_E_01.

items.name: Piano (brown)
items.notes: Also has SCR_PlayInstrument; black variant exists. Good for pub, church and school hall.

items.name: Coffin
items.notes: In church crypts (Church_01_crypt_attic); destructible. A church or funeral RP prop. Placed near (within about 0.6 x the building size of its origin; approximate): Saint Philippe: Church_01_red; Morton: Church_01_blue_nocellar; Montignac: Church_01_yellow.

items.name: Suitcase
items.notes: Luggage prop; destructible; no pick-up or loot action, so decoration for a hotel or station.

items.name: Shop counter
items.notes: Generic counter; stand-in for a hotel reception desk since no reception prop exists.

items.name: Coat rack
items.notes: Very common; stand-in for a hotel or reception coat stand; variants CoatRack_02 to 05.

items.name: Single bed
items.notes: Destructible; no sleep action (LF adds beds via LF_HospitalBedComponent).

items.name: Double bed
items.notes: Hotel-room style bed; destructible; no sleep action.

items.name: Police control panel
items.notes: Police station console prop; mesh only here; LF has its own dispatch console prefabs.

items.name: Ambulance UAZ-452
items.notes: Heal support station (range 7 m) plus load and remove-casualty actions, vehicle storage and the usual vehicle actions. Soviet-era look fits 1989 civilian use; the _FIA variant has the same components.

items.name: Ambulance UAZ-452 (FIA)
items.notes: FIA-painted UAZ-452 ambulance; inherits the heal station and load-casualty components from the base.

items.name: Ambulance M997 Maxi
items.notes: US Humvee ambulance, 4.8 m long; the heal support station sits in its ambulance box part, with load and remove-casualty actions. LF flagship ambulance is LF_M997_Ambulance.
